scope: Patient-held-out development assessment within previously studied source/validation patients; original unseen26 and SAILOR excluded

render.rows: First two sorted scoring visits with positive masks, not selected by error

limits: Scoring patients were studied historically and are not untouched validation
Matched schedule does not establish individually optimal or fully converged training
Two seeds do not establish unrestricted training-seed uncertainty
Automated masks and native volumes are proxy targets, not biological truth
Intensity standardization cancels much of the intensity perturbation; resolution stress removes anatomical detail
This is single-scan state estimation, not forecasting, a clinical comparator, or JEPA attribution
No new setting, seed, threshold, or checkpoint may be selected from these scoring outcomes
Within-study patient disjointness does not independently establish the pretraining corpus has no patient overlap

verification.scope: Executed artifact and numerical verification, not independent scientific review
